title: 3 reasons quantum computing will change everything

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if quantum computing could solve problems we've never imagined—within our lifetime?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, we have 128-qubit processors. They're cracking encryption and optimizing supply chains at unprecedented speeds.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this could break global security systems and widen the gap between those who control quantum tech and those who don't.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We're developing post-quantum cryptography and open-source tools to ensure secure transitions for all nations.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where quantum simulations cure diseases and make clean energy affordable for everyone.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just faster—it’s smarter, fairer, and more inclusive, if we build it right.

video_cue: A scientist and engineer collaborating at a quantum lab, surrounded by glowing circuits and holographic data streams.
